sn22.157:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhāti || || 4
sn22.157:1.4: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā || || 6-9
sn22.157:1.8: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā || || 10
sn22.157:1.10: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.157:1.13: api nu tam anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā ti || ||
